_comment: sibyl-memory runs as a sidecar next to VIGIL's own MCP gateway, pointed
at the SAME SQLite file the firewall reads. That shared path is the
point: an agent inspecting its own memory and the firewall enforcing on
that memory are looking at one database, not two copies that can drift.
Set SIBYL_DB_PATH to match VIGIL's, or both default to
~/.sibyl-memory/memory.db and agree by accident rather than by design.
